title: Fill, Gradient, Stroke & Pressure Profiles
subtitle: Linear, Elliptical, Radial, Conical Gradients, Brush Pressure Curves, Contour Tool
description: Transform flat vector paths into rich, dimensional illustrations using the Fill Tool (G), 5 gradient types, custom stroke dash patterns, dynamic pressure graphs for tapered calligraphy, the Contour Tool (O), and Expand Stroke for production.
prerequisites: D02: Vector Nodes, Paths & Pen Tool Geometry
D03: Advanced Shape Creation & Boolean Geometry
learningOutcomes: Master the Fill Tool (G) across Linear, Radial, Elliptical, and Conical gradients.
Add, position, reverse, and modulate midpoints and opacity stops along gradient ramps.
Sculpt dynamic stroke taper profiles using the Stroke Studio Pressure graph.
Generate concentric offset outlines and inward insets using the Contour Tool (O).
Bake variable strokes and contour offsets into permanent filled vectors using Expand Stroke.

capstoneProject.title: Brushed Metal Chronograph Watch Dial
capstoneProject.description: Construct an ultra-realistic luxury chronograph dial featuring a 360-degree Conical brushed metal texture, dynamic tapered pressure tick marks, and an offset bezel using the Contour Tool.
evaluationCriteria: Dial background utilizes a 360-degree Conical gradient simulating brushed steel.
Tick marks feature custom pressure curves or tapered stroke profiles.
Bezel rim constructed using Contour Tool (O) or Expand Stroke.
